title: Gaussian Process
description: A flowing stream of Gaussian process draws. Once the screen fills with prior draws, a hidden function is drawn in, points are observed on it one by one and the draws bend through them. Then it fades to black and starts again in new colors.

params.samples: How many draws are on screen at once (0–120, default 40)
params.lengthscale: Kernel lengthscale; higher means smoother curves (0.3–5, default 1.0)
